mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances meeting the joint trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances economic efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant difference in 20-day forward returns between periods of INDPRO growth and baseline during non-recessionary regimes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it indicates broader economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 55% of months with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds a 6-month average increase of 2.5%, indicating heightened inflation concerns, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively impacted over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate monetary tightening.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant difference in 20-day forward returns between periods meeting the CPIAUCSL trigger and baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS showing a year-over-year increase of > 2.5% signals an overheating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated inflation and monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances meeting the joint trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding a 3-month average of $450k, indicating strong retail sales, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals robust consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive correlation between RSAFS growth and 5-day forward SPX returns (Pearson's r < 0.10).
